messages:
Alex (Sales): kicking off the Concorde POC thread — they want 2 weeks, three prioritized flows, and clear success metrics. main ask: validate latency/cost for a customer-facing summarization + entity extraction pipeline, and a few creative completions for product copy.
Sam S. (SE): SGTM. can we clarify required endpoints? i'm thinking /generate-chat for copy, /embed-search for similarity, /extract for entities.
Maria (Concorde): correct. primary is Summarize+Entities for transcripts (call center). copy generation is secondary. SLA target: p95 < 450ms for <1k token responses.
Tess (CSM): note on pricing: hosted trial credits cover small volume, but for stable load we'll recommend Dedicated preview — we should show cost delta in the POC report. i'll prepare a rough per-1k-token comparison.
Sam S. (SE): for evals i propose: 1) latency/cost bench with 1000 synthetic requests (mix short/long), 2) quality evals: 200 transcript samples, metrics: entity F1, summary ROUGE-L / human-check sampling, 3) regression checks vs their baseline model.
Alex (Sales): sounds good. timeline idea: week 1 = infra + baseline runs, week 2 = quality evals + customer review. any blockers?
Noah (Security): quick sec note — Concorde will send PII in transcripts. need to confirm: a) encryption in flight & at rest (we have KMS options), b) data retention policy for POC (default logs disabled?), c) if dedicated VPC is required for the POC. they also asked about SOC2 docs.
Maria (Concorde): for POC we can avoid long-term retention, hashes are fine. VPC would be preferred but not mandatory for the trial. we will want evidence of KMS + SOC2 report before moving to prod.
Sam S. (SE): action items from SE side: - spin up hosted endpoints with prefix caching enabled - create an eval harness (pytest + small harness) that runs the 200 transcript quality checks and outputs F1/ROUGE csv - provide sample prompt templates and a reproducible request script. example prompt fragment:
```
System: You are a call summarizer.
User: Transcript below. Extract agent actions and customer intents, then return a 3-sentence summary.
```
and an example eval command:
```bash
python run_eval.py --endpoint https://api.redwood.run/v1/extract --samples samples/200.jsonl --out results.csv
```
Tess (CSM): i'll prepare a slide with cost delta (hosted vs dedicated) and a POC acceptance checklist (SLOs, quality gates, support window for onboarding).
Alex (Sales): pricing question from procurement: are POC usage credits transferrable to committed reserved capacity if they convert? Tess:
Tess (CSM): short answer: credits are not transferrable, but we can offset first invoice in negotiation. will confirm with finance.
Noah (Security): i'll send the minimal set of docs they need and a short questionnaire. also note: if we enable prefix caching, we should confirm cache key policy (no raw PII in keys).
Maria (Concorde): acceptance criteria from our side: - p95 latency <= 450ms (for 90% of calls) - entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 - summaries pass human spot-check (>= 4/5) - sample throughput 5 rps sustained without errors.
Alex (Sales): perfect. next steps: Sam to deliver eval harness and initial bench by EOD Wednesday (3 days), Tess to send cost slide + finance answer, Noah to share security checklist, Maria will provide 200 transcript samples in anonymized form. i'll schedule a mid-week sync. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deployment started for test cluster redwood-poc-180765 — logs: https://deploys.redwood/180765 (ETA ~ 20m)
Sam S. (SE): ack — i'll watch logs and post results here when bench is done.
Alex (Sales): thanks all — keeping this thread as single source for POC artifacts and decisions.
